message.content:
**Columbia University**

| Category | Details |
|----------|---------|
| **Location** | New York City, New York (Manhattan) |
| **Founded** | 1754 (as King's College) – oldest institution of higher education in the United States |
| **Type** | Ivy League private research university |
| **Campus** | Main campus on Morningside Heights; also has several satellite campuses in Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Washington, D.C. |
| **Student Body** | ~30,000 students (undergraduate, graduate, professional, and non‑degree) |
| **Academic Structure** | 16 schools & colleges, including Columbia College (undergrad), School of Engineering & Applied Science, Graduate School of Arts & Sciences, Business School, Law School, Medical Center, etc. |
| **Notable Programs** | Journalism (Columbia Journalism School), Law, Medicine, Business, Architecture, Computer Science, Environmental Science, etc. |
| **Research** | Major research initiatives in fields like climate science, neuroscience, artificial intelligence, public health, and more. |
| **Athletics** | NCAA Division I; teams known as the Lions; competes in the Ivy League. |
| **Alumni** | Includes 5 U.S. Presidents (e.g., Theodore Roosevelt, Franklin D. Roosevelt), 9 Nobel laureates, 2 Pulitzer Prize winners, 1 Turing Award winner, and many influential figures in politics, business, arts, and sciences. |
| **Website** | https://www.columbia.edu/ |

If you need specific details—such as admissions statistics, tuition costs, or program rankings—just let me know!
